fusions.name: Probing Cantrip
fusions.desc: A measured bolt of arcana that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Controlled Release
fusions.desc: Lets raw arcana out in every direction, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Centring Breath
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Wasted
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you gain a shield worth 6% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
